description: Polish single-file cafe landing page: sticky nav + CTA, hero + USP, offer (menu/promotions/reservations/catering/location/hours), social proof, gallery, About, FAQ, schema.org footer, accessible.

criteria: site-cafe.html is one self-contained, responsive Polish landing page for the 'Pod Bukiem' cafe: sticky nav with a CTA, a hero with a USP, the offer (menu, promotions, reservations, catering, location, hours), social proof, a gallery, an About section, an FAQ, and a footer with schema.org JSON-LD; semantic markup with aria labels; no frameworks.
